reason: No reachable own website or contact route: the channel (UCmMivlFSW35ZzLwy5iQHOkA, 16,100 subscribers, Data API 10 Nov 2026) gives no website; two web searches found only directory listings and a possible site, www.vedantaphx.org (Vedanta Society of Phoenix, Tempe), whose robots.txt request failed to connect (no other host tried).
